svg.title: From Cohere Transcribe to streaming ASR
svg.desc: Comparison of the offline Conformer encoder-decoder and our streaming student: incremental features, causal time convolutions, chunk-limited attention, encoder caches, and periodic text decoding. Attention sees cached past and its current chunk; later chunks are hidden.
svg.title: From Cohere Transcribe to streaming ASR

cc:Work.dc:title: From Cohere Transcribe to streaming ASR
cc:Work.dc:description: Offline Conformer encoder-decoder compared with the chunked, cache-aware streaming student.
